metadata.Syllabus Name: Server-Side development with NodeJS, Express, and MongoDB_Phát triển Server-Side với NodeJS, Express và MongoDB
metadata.Course Name English: Server-Side development with NodeJS, Express, and MongoDB
metadata.Learning-Teaching Method: Lecture,Project based learning,Active learning,Social Constructivism, Discussion
metadata.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1 h final exam + 85' practical exam + 104h self-study
metadata.Description: This course tackles all the problems related to NodeJS-based web servers. Contents to be implemented include: - Overview of Web protocols: HTTP and HTTPS. - Introduction of NodeJS and frameworks such as ExpressJS, NestJS, Hono to build a web server. - Introduction of simple templating languages such as EJB and HandleBar . - Deploy the application on a web server with basic CRUD operations. Work with NoSQL databases, specifically MongoDB and Mongoose, to access MongoDB from NodeJS. - Overview of REST and building a RESTful API. - Learn Authentication and security-related issues for web applications. - Integrate React app with server NodeJs - Deploy server-based applications with Hosting Services
metadata.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Constantly follow announcements on FU CMS at https://cmshn.fpt.edu.vn/ and FU FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.
metadata.Tools: - Visual Studio Code (https://code.visualstudio.com) - Postman - MongoDBCompass - Internet

sections.heading: Syllabus Details
rows: Server-Side development with NodeJS, Express, and MongoDB_Phát triển Server-Side với NodeJS, Express và MongoDB
Server-Side development with NodeJS, Express, and MongoDB
Lecture,Project based learning,Active learning,Social Constructivism, Discussion
Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1 h final exam + 85' practical exam + 104h self-study

This course tackles all the problems related to NodeJS-based web servers. Contents to be implemented include: - Overview of Web protocols: HTTP and HTTPS. - Introduction of NodeJS and frameworks such as ExpressJS, NestJS, Hono to build a web server. - Introduction of simple templating languages such as EJB and HandleBar . - Deploy the application on a web server with basic CRUD operations. Work with NoSQL databases, specifically MongoDB and Mongoose, to access MongoDB from NodeJS. - Overview of REST and building a RESTful API. - Learn Authentication and security-related issues for web applications. - Integrate React app with server NodeJs - Deploy server-based applications with Hosting Services

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Constantly follow announcements on FU CMS at https://cmshn.fpt.edu.vn/ and FU FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.
- Visual Studio Code (https://code.visualstudio.com) - Postman - MongoDBCompass - Internet

Be able to use Backend as a Service (BaaS) to enhance secure communication between client and server applications
